lessons.title: Position sizing in a different price range
lessons.objective: Calculate a whole-share position size while including estimated adverse slippage.

sections.title: Attempt before reviewing
sections.body: A long plan uses entry 48.20, stop 47.95, maximum risk 40, and slippage 0.03 per share.
sections.prompt: Calculate the risk per share and maximum whole-share quantity.
sections.answer: Risk is 0.28 per share. The maximum whole-share quantity is 142.

sections.title: Explain the constraint
sections.body: Explain why rounding up to 143 would violate the stated maximum risk.

mastery_criteria: Explains why buying power is not the sizing rule
